svg.title: LQR: position gains from the model
svg.desc: Animated graph of cost against how hard it pushes, from softer to harder. A red curve, the cost of being off, falls as it pushes harder; a green curve, the cost of volts spent, rises; a dark curve is their total, lowest in the middle at a dashed line marked LQR's kP and kD. A cursor slides to the soft end, where being off costs most, then to the hard end, where volts cost most, and back to the dashed line. A stacked bar of being off plus volts follows it and is shortest, at the dashed level marked least, at LQR's choice. Like braking for a stop sign: too soft, you miss the line; too hard, you jolt everyone. The tool says missing by 2% of the move is as bad as using 7 volts.
svg.text: LQR: position gains from the model
LQR balances two costs: how far off it is, and how many volts it spends.
Like braking for a stop sign: too soft, you miss the line; too hard,
you jolt everyone. LQR finds the gains with the least total.
The tool says missing by 2% of the move is as bad as using 7 volts.
